assertionSteps.title: 1. Given Admin A uses subject "admin-a" with role "FMO_ADMIN" in an isolated authenticated browser
2. And the controlled Category fixture records the initial grid rows and persisted values
3. And the controlled creation clock returns 1700000000000 milliseconds

steps.title: Set fixed time "Wed Nov 15 2023 06:13:20 GMT+0800 (Singapore Standard Time)"

assertionSteps.title: 4. And the baseline fixture data defines "Category Label" as "case-027"
5. And an existing Category record already has "Category Label" equal to "shared-a"
6. When Admin A clicks the button labeled "Create New Category" on the Category administration page
7. Then the dialog titled "new ID: 1700000000000" is visible on the Category administration page
8. When Admin A fills the textbox labeled "Category Label" with "shared-a" in dialog "new ID: 1700000000000"
9. And Admin A clicks the button labeled "Create" in dialog "new ID: 1700000000000"
10. Then the alert with severity "error" in the portal snackbar contains the exact text "Record not created."
